title: Install and configure Auth.js v5 with Drizzle adapter and database sessions
acceptance_criteria: Auth.js config created at lib/auth.ts with DrizzleAdapter pointing to DB schema
Credentials provider (email+password) configured with bcrypt hashing
Session callback embeds tenant_id into session object
auth() helper exported for server-side session access
signIn/signOut functions exported for client-side use
completion_summary: Installed next-auth@5.0.0-beta.31, @auth/drizzle-adapter, bcryptjs. Created lib/auth.ts with DrizzleAdapter (credentials + Google OAuth), route handler at app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts. Updated schema with adapter-compatible property names (camelCase) + authenticators table. Regenerated migration (10 tables).
